# MH-16 — Join a waiting list

**Business value:** 900

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker

I want to join a waiting list when a meal slot is full

So that I can be offered a table if space becomes available


## Notes

- hikers must join a waiting list with a reservation put on hold, i.e. inserting all necessary information (date, time, party size, optional additional requirements)
- notification are sent to the first booking in the waiting list which matches seats availability;  the process continues until it is possible (i.e. either there are suitable bookings in the waiting list or an hiker notified confirms )
